defuss-shadcn / Website / website-blog

Blog

Blocks for the front of a blog or a category: the header with subscribe actions and category chips, the post previews - card, horizontal or featured - and the archive by year and month. Every block is CSS-only and built from the library's components and tokens.

On this page (3)
The templateA blog frontThe blocks

§The template

The Blog blocks composed into one page - the source is the page. The categories and the archive months are routes of defuss-dom-router (#/category/design, #/archive/2026/09) that filter the posts, and every post opens its page (#/post/designing-for-calm): one view filled from the page's data block - the essay, its author, the posts before and after it and what to read next. The language switch translates the frame with defuss-i18n and the posts with it - the data block holds each one in English and German, and the dates are formatted for the language. Subscribe and About open Dialogs.

Open full screen

§A blog front

Routes filter the posts (#/category/engineering, #/archive/2026/10) and open them (#/post/offline-sync); the switch translates the frame and the posts. A Site Header, the Blog Header, a featured Blog Item, a grid of cards and the Archive Index in a sidebar; the post view composes Article Header, Article Body, Author Bio and Article Navigation; a Site Footer closes the journal.

×%

§The blocks

Blog Header

Introduces a blog with its title and editorial description - actions (subscribe, RSS), category chips, centered or on a banner.

Blog Item

Previews one post with its image, excerpt, and metadata - a card, a horizontal row, or a featured post with the copy over the image.

Archive Index

Links to content grouped by publication year or month - native disclosures with post counts, or the years side by side.
